risk_note: RV1 (contract only). Two new planned operations (BR-WDR-10, BR-WDR-05, BR-WDR-17; D10-595): adminBatchApproveWithdrawals, each id on its own transaction with its own result, and adminRejectWithdrawal, with the five reason codes a person can choose. withdraw.review, totp step-up, idempotent, audited. Three new 20001 data.reason values registered: reject_attempt_exists, reject_query_required, reject_query_success. A withdrawal with hold_reason=payer_side_after_transfer must have a usable latest query before it is rejected, or a transfer the channel in fact paid would be paid twice; 「订单不存在」 has no verified channel code yet, so it is refused like other unknown results until one is registered. withdrawal-commands.ts does not have this guard today; B2-09k adds it in the domain command. No existing operation changes, no migration.

reviews.note: Independent Claude via claude-run.sh under approvals 36, Codex not logged in. r1 fail: S0, a payer-side withdrawal could be rejected and paid twice; S1, the new reason was not registered. That last edit is text only and had no third round. Static, no tests run by the reviewer.
